faq.q: ¿Necesito de pago alguna base de datos?
faq.a: No. Solo usa búsqueda web y fuentes públicas y gratuitas, y respeta robots.txt.

en.title: Lead finding and scoring
en.summary: Finds companies matching your ideal customer through web search, or prioritizes an existing list, scored by fit and buying intent.
useWhen: You have an ICP and want new matching companies
You already have a company list and need it ranked by priority
You want to know who to contact this week
notFor: Getting verified personal emails or phone numbers
en.output: A CSV, leads_[icp]_[date].csv, with scores, A/B/C tier, reason and source, plus a top-10 summary table in the conversation.

faq.q: Does it make up emails or contact details?
faq.a: No. If a name or email cannot be verified from public sources, the field is left as research needed. An email pattern may go in a separate column marked unverified.

faq.q: Do I need a paid database?
faq.a: No. It uses only web search and public, free sources, and respects robots.txt.

faq.q: Can I give it my own list?
faq.a: Yes. Given a file or a list of companies it switches to enrich mode: it keeps your columns and appends the enrichment and scoring columns.
